# Turn Economy: Batch Reads, Early Writes

Budget awareness prevents analysis paralysis.

## Independent calls

Aggregate reads that do not depend on each other’s outputs. After results land, plan the next independent batch.

## Early implementation rule

If intake threatens to consume the budget before an artefact exists, cut scope to a correct slice you can prove now; chain follow-ups explicitly.

## Proof coupling

Attach verification to the same wave as implementation when tooling allows—proof drift is a common late-turn failure.

## Exit clarity

The assistant turn that matters is the one that produces or validates persistent artefacts—not the one that sounds confident.
